title: useAgentChat stops working when new worker is deployed
body:
When the page is currently open and you deploy a new version of the worker (or redeploy), it seems like the websocket is reconnected. However, when sending new messages, it will just hang. You will need to refresh to get everything working again.

How do we fix this? The "status" and "error" value from useAgentChat shows no indication of an error.
author: ruqqq

comments.body: I'm not sure what exactly fixed it, but not facing this issue anymore. Could be upgrading to the latest agent-sdk fixes it. Eitherway, I'll close this issue for now @threepointone
